//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the DOT-LEADERS CONTAINER — the `.pa-dot-leaders` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.DataDisplay.dot_leaders/1`, svelte `display/DotLeaders.svelte`). Restaurant-menu / invoice shape: rows of `label ……… value` with a dotted leader line. SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY, same as list.json. The harness renders one component whose slot receives plain TEXT (both dumpers HTML-escape it), so the per-ROW markup can't flow through the slot; the body area is a bare text token. The rows are a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte `DotLeadersItem`, keen `dot_leader/1`) passed as children — their element classes (__item / __label / __leader / __value) and the per-row element-modifier __item--total are the DEFERRED sub-slice (acknowledged prose, not container markup). This fixture proves ONLY what the container emits: its <div> tag, its pa-dot-leaders class, and class passthrough. The .pa-dot-leaders BLOCK has ZERO block-level `--` modifiers (grep '\.pa-dot-leaders--' on main.css is empty) — only element classes + the __item--total element-modifier. So the container contract is minimal.

propsVocabulary.body: the dot-leaders row area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (the real pa-dot-leaders__item rows are the deferred sub-slice, rendered by DotLeadersItem / dot_leader which both dumpers can't flow through a text slot)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the dot-leaders container adds no attribute conventions. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not rich row content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-dot-leaders BLOCK has NO modifiers (no pa-dot-leaders--* exists). Its only classes are the four __element classes + the __item--total element-modifier, all DEFERRED below (owned by the row sub-component, not the container). So the container contract is just the base class + a body slot + a class passthrough. capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to block modifiers (pa-dot-leaders--*), of which there are none.

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; row structure is the deferred sub-slice

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ROW element classes + the per-row element-modifier of the pa-dot-leaders block — NOT container markup. Owned by the row sub-component (svelte DotLeadersItem, keen dot_leader/1), which both dumpers pass as plain escaped text through the container's slot and so cannot render here. There is no row-FRAGMENT fixture (neither wrapper registers one), so these are ACKNOWLEDGED PROSE deferrals (reported, not verified against another fixture). NOTE a known wrapper divergence lives in the deferred row sub-component: keen's dot_leader/1 wraps the __label/__value text in <strong> on is_total, whereas the core snippet (snippets/data-display.html) and svelte's DotLeadersItem rely purely on the __item--total CSS (font-weight:700) with NO <strong>. That divergence is OUT OF SCOPE here (container-only) and would be caught by a future row-fragment fixture.
deferred.pa-dot-leaders__item: row element — owned by the DotLeadersItem / dot_leader sub-component (slot child), not the container
deferred.pa-dot-leaders__item--total: per-row element-modifier (total/summary row: top divider + heavier weight) — set via isTotal / is_total on the row sub-component
deferred.pa-dot-leaders__label: row label element — owned by the row sub-component
deferred.pa-dot-leaders__leader: row dotted-leader element — owned by the row sub-component
deferred.pa-dot-leaders__value: row value element — owned by the row sub-component
